text.hi: आज की कहानी: ‘The Lost Bird’ (खोई हुई चिड़िया)। पहले कुछ शब्द सीखते हैं।
text.hinglish: Aaj ki kahani: ‘The Lost Bird’ (Khoi hui chidiya). Pehle kuch shabd seekhte hain.
text.en: Today's story: ‘The Lost Bird’. First, a few words.

text.hi: ‘bird’ मतलब चिड़िया। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘bird’ matlab chidiya. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘bird’ means चिड़िया. Tap to listen, then say it.

text.hi: ‘nest’ मतलब घोंसला। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘nest’ matlab ghosla. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘nest’ means घोंसला. Tap to listen, then say it.

text.hi: ‘afraid’ मतलब डरा हुआ। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘afraid’ matlab dara hua. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘afraid’ means डरा हुआ. Tap to listen, then say it.

sentences: A small bird falls from a tree.
Amit sees it on the ground.
"Do not be afraid," he says softly.
He picks up the bird with care.
He puts it back in the nest.

question.en: Where did the bird fall from?

question.hi: अमित चिड़िया को कहाँ रखता है?
question.hinglish: Amit chidiya ko kahan rakhta hai?
question.en: Where does Amit put the bird?
